triage.kind_span: OFFER TO PURCHASE 400,000 SHARES OF COMMON STOCK FOR CASH

subject_names.span: the issuer is MacKenzie Realty Capital, Inc., a real estate investment trust incorporated in Maryland

security_class.span: 400,000 shares of its issued and outstanding common stock, par value $0.0001 per share

price_basis.span: The offer is for cash at a purchase price equal to $6.00 per Share

size_shares.span: We are offering to purchase up to 400,000 Shares.

commencement_date.span: The Offer period will begin March 19, 2021

expiration_date.span: The Offer will expire at 5:00 p.m., Pacific Time, on April 19, 2021

proration.span: If the amount of repurchase requests exceeds the number of Shares we seek to repurchase, we will repurchase Shares on a pro rata basis.

spans: (i) material legal action or proceeding instituted or threatened which challenges, in the Board’s judgment, the Offer or otherwise materially adversely affects the Company
(ii) declaration of a banking moratorium by federal, state or foreign authorities or any suspension of payment by banks in the United States
(v) other event or condition that, in the Board’s judgment, would have a material adverse effect on the Company or its Stockholders

trigger_origin.span: This Offer has been approved by the Board.

notes: Issuer tender by a non-listed REIT (the filing says it is transitioning from a BDC to a property-focused REIT). Fixed cash price of $6.00 per Share; the filing states an Estimated Per-Share NAV of $9.84 as of December 31, 2020 and that 'The purchase price is 39% lower than Estimated Per-Share NAV', so price_pct_nav is left null (a percent of NAV would need arithmetic). final_price_per_share is left null because this is the offer document, not a results amendment; the stated offer price is $6.00. size_pct_outstanding is null: 400,000 of 13,362,419.23 shares outstanding as of March 19, 2021 would need arithmetic (the FAQ's 'If we buy back 5% of our shares' is hypothetical). Conditions also include 'if such purchase will cause us to be in violation of the securities, commodities or other laws', a limitation on extension of credit and war or calamity (read as market_disruption). trigger_origin read as board_discretionary: a one-off Board-approved liquidity offer while the regular share repurchase program is suspended (since May 2020); periodic_liquidity is the alternative reading. Not conditioned on any minimum number of Shares. No ticker: the Shares are not traded on an established market.
